lines.text: In one minute, you'll have picked a direction, and left a note.
lines.source_text: In one minute, you'll have picked a direction, and left a note.

lines.text: Step one: open the board. Claude runs showtime studio open, and gives you a private, local link.
lines.source_text: Step one: open the board. Claude runs showtime studio open, and gives you a private, local link.

lines.text: The link opens the board in your browser. Each concept is a card, with style frames, a hook, a palette, and a music sketch.
lines.source_text: The link opens the board in your browser. Each concept is a card, with style frames, a hook, a palette, and a music sketch.

lines.text: Step two: compare. Click the thumbnails to step through a concept's style frames.
lines.source_text: Step two: compare. Click the thumbnails to step through a concept's style frames.

lines.text: Press play to hear its music sketch: ten seconds of the bed it would use.
lines.source_text: Press play to hear its music sketch: ten seconds of the bed it would use.

lines.text: Further down, Compare puts two concepts side by side. Drag across the frame to wipe from one to the other.
lines.source_text: Further down, Compare puts two concepts side by side. Drag across the frame to wipe from one to the other.

lines.text: Step three: react. Press L to like the concept in focus, or click the heart.
lines.source_text: Step three: react. Press L to like the concept in focus, or click the heart.

lines.text: Press C to leave a note, in your own words. Rough is fine.
lines.source_text: Press C to leave a note, in your own words. Rough is fine.

lines.text: Control Enter sends it. Every reaction is saved to the job as you go.
lines.source_text: Control Enter sends it. Every reaction is saved to the job as you go.

lines.text: Step four: pick. Click Pick on the direction you want.
lines.source_text: Step four: pick. Click Pick on the direction you want.

lines.text: Press the full stop key to review everything you've sent.
lines.source_text: Press the full stop key to review everything you've sent.

lines.text: Then tell Claude you're done. It runs studio feedback, reads your pick and your note, and builds from your choice.
lines.source_text: Then tell Claude you're done. It runs studio feedback, reads your pick and your note, and builds from your choice.

lines.text: Open, compare, react, pick. The full guide is the studio reference, in the showtime skill.
lines.source_text: Open, compare, react, pick. The full guide is the studio reference, in the showtime skill.
